topic: {由紀|ゆき} works on a Saturday
title_jp: {土曜|どよう}なのに{仕事|しごと}？
context: Saturday 21 November, lunchtime. アルちゃん runs the reception of ゲストハウス{風|かぜ} alone while {健太|けんた} cooks for tonight's showdown; in {東京|とうきょう}, {由紀|ゆき} is stuck at the office on her day off and wants to talk about work culture.
scene: Lunch break at reception. {由紀|ゆき} is working on a Saturday in {東京|とうきょう} and wants your opinion on Japanese work culture.

phrases.jp: {田中|たなか}さんのおかげで、{仕事|しごと}に{慣れました|なれました|to get used to|4}。
phrases.en: Thanks to you, {田中|たなか}さん, I've got used to the work.
phrases.note: Thanking a host or boss. You'll hear back いえいえ or {頑張|がんば}ったからだよ.

phrases.jp: {日本|にほん}の{働き方|はたらきかた|way of working|3}について、どう{思います|おもいます}か？
phrases.en: What do you think about the way people work in Japan?
phrases.note: 〜についてどう{思|おも}いますか: the standard way to ask an opinion.

phrases.jp: {確かに|たしかに|true, indeed|4}。でも、ちょっと{違う|ちがう}と{思う|おもう}な。
phrases.en: True. But I think it's a bit different.
phrases.note: Agree first, then disagree softly: the Japanese way to push back.

phrases.jp: それは{人|ひと}に{よる||to depend on|4}んじゃない？
phrases.en: Doesn't that depend on the person?
phrases.note: 〜による = it depends on. Politely: {人|ひと}によると{思|おも}います.

phrases.jp: {有給|ゆうきゅう|paid leave|3}、{取りにくい|とりにくい}んだよね。
phrases.en: It's hard to take paid leave, you know.
phrases.note: {有給|ゆうきゅう} is short for {有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}. 〜にくい = hard to do.

dialogue_setting: LINE, Saturday lunchtime: {由紀|ゆき} at her office in {東京|とうきょう}, アルちゃん behind the reception desk of ゲストハウス{風|かぜ}.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: {土曜|どよう}なのに{休日出勤|きゅうじつしゅっきん|working on a day off|2}なう…マジむり
dialogue.en: Working on my day off, it's Saturday… seriously, I can't.
dialogue.note: なう = 'right now' (from English 'now'), old Twitter slang. マジむり = {本当|ほんとう}に{無理|むり}.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: {部長|ぶちょう|department head|3}が{月曜|げつよう}までに{資料|しりょう|documents, materials|3}ほしいって
dialogue.en: My department head wants the documents by Monday.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: え、{土曜|どよう}も？スペインだったら、みんな{文句|もんく|complaint|3}{言う|いう}よｗ
dialogue.en: What, Saturdays too? In Spain everyone would complain, lol.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: {日本|にほん}は「{上司|じょうし|boss|3}より{先|さき}に{帰りにくい|かえりにくい}」って{空気|くうき|atmosphere, mood|4}あるじゃん
dialogue.en: In Japan there's this feeling that it's hard to leave before your boss, right?

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: {ぶっちゃけ||(slang) to be blunt|3}、{長く|ながく}{働く|はたらく}のが{偉い|えらい|admirable, great|4}って{考え方|かんがえかた|way of thinking|4}、{古い|ふるい}と{思う|おもう}
dialogue.en: To be blunt, I think the idea that working long hours is admirable is outdated.
dialogue.note: ぶっちゃけ = {正直|しょうじき}に{言|い}うと (honestly speaking).

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {確かに|たしかに|true, indeed|4}。でも{日本|にほん}の{仕事|しごと}って、{丁寧|ていねい|careful, polite|4}で{真面目|まじめ|serious, diligent|4}だと{思う|おもう}な
dialogue.en: True. But I think work in Japan is careful and serious.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {今日|きょう}は{一人|ひとり}だけど、{健太|けんた}が{渡して|わたして|to hand over|4}くれたメモのおかげで{何とか|なんとか|somehow|4}なってる！
dialogue.en: I'm alone today, but thanks to the note {健太|けんた} gave me, I'm managing!

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: {偉い|えらい|admirable, great|4}じゃん！で、{夜|よる}の{対決|たいけつ|showdown|3}は{勝てそう|かてそう}？
dialogue.en: Well done you! So, tonight's showdown: think you'll win?

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {恵子|けいこ}さんのじゃがいものおかげで、{自信|じしん|confidence|4}あるよ！
dialogue.en: Thanks to {恵子|けいこ}さん's potatoes, I'm feeling confident!

listening.intro: Through the open window, the station next door makes an announcement.
listening.title: {鷹ノ原駅|たかのはらえき}のお{知らせ|しらせ}
listening.place: {鷹ノ原駅|たかのはらえき}, next to the guesthouse

lines.jp: お{知らせ|しらせ}します。{長野|ながの}{方面|ほうめん|direction (of)|2}からの{電車|でんしゃ}は、{約|やく}20{分|ぷん}{遅れて|おくれて}おります。
lines.en: An announcement. The train from {長野|ながの} is running about 20 minutes late.

lines.jp: {線路|せんろ|railway track|3}に{鹿|しか|deer|3}が{入った|はいった}ためです。ご{迷惑|めいわく|trouble, inconvenience|3}をおかけして、{申し訳|もうしわけ}ございません。
lines.en: This is because a deer got onto the track. We apologise for the inconvenience.

listening.question: {電車|でんしゃ}はどうして{遅|おく}れていますか。
options: {鹿|しか}が{線路|せんろ}に{入|はい}ったから
{雪|ゆき}がたくさん{降|ふ}ったから
{乗|の}る{人|ひと}が{多|おお}いから
listening.explain: {鹿|しか}が{入|はい}ったためです: ため gives the formal reason. Deer on the line are common in {長野|ながの}, and some guests will check in late.

grammar.form: noun: + のおかげで ({健太|けんた}のおかげで, メモのおかげで) · verb: plain form + おかげで ({飲|の}んだおかげで, {来|き}てくれたおかげで) · い-adj: + おかげで ({近|ちか}いおかげで) · な-adj: + なおかげで ({元気|げんき}なおかげで)
grammar.explanation: Gives the cause of a good result, with a feeling of thanks. For bad results use 〜せいで instead. Said about a bad result, おかげで turns sarcastic: {雨|あめ}のおかげでびしょびしょ = 'thanks a lot, rain'.
mark: じゃがいものおかげで

examples.jp: {薬|くすり}を{飲んだ|のんだ}おかげで、{熱|ねつ}が{下がった|さがった}。
examples.en: Thanks to the medicine, my fever went down.

examples.jp: {駅|えき}が{近い|ちかい}おかげで、{通勤|つうきん|commuting|3}が{楽|らく}だ。
examples.en: Because the station is close, commuting is easy.

examples.jp: {先生|せんせい}のおかげで、{試験|しけん}に{合格|ごうかく|passing (an exam)|3}できました。
examples.en: Thanks to my teacher, I passed the exam.

quiz.question: {友達|ともだち}が{手伝って|てつだって}くれた＿＿、{早く|はやく}{終わった|おわった}。
quiz.en: Thanks to my friend's help, I finished early.
quiz.explain: After a verb, おかげで joins directly; の is only for nouns. せいで would blame the friend.

quiz_more.question: {雨|あめ}の＿＿、{試合|しあい}が{中止|ちゅうし|cancellation|3}になった。
quiz_more.en: Because of the rain, the match was cancelled.
quiz_more.explain: A cancelled match is a bad result, so せいで. おかげで here would sound sarcastic.

quiz_more.question: この{町|まち}は{静か|しずか}＿＿、よく{眠れる|ねむれる}。
quiz_more.en: This town is quiet, so I sleep well.
quiz_more.explain: な-adjectives keep な before おかげで: {静|しず}かなおかげで.

kanji.where: On the small sign アルちゃん hangs on the guesthouse door at lunchtime: tonight every bed is taken.
kanji.breakdown: {満室|まんしつ}: 満 full + 室 room → 'rooms full'. Booking sites show it too.
kanji.related: {空室|くうしつ} = vacancy (空 empty + 室 room).

tip.title: Leaving before the others
tip.body: When you leave work while others stay, say お{先|さき}に{失礼|しつれい}します; they answer お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}です. Many workers still don't use all their {有給|ゆうきゅう} because of the 空気, but younger people and new rules are slowly changing that.

challenge.prompt: {由紀|ゆき}: 「で、アルちゃんはどう{思う|おもう}？スペインと{日本|にほん}、どっちの{働き方|はたらきかた|way of working|3}がいい？」 Give your opinion, and thank her for teaching you about Japanese offices.
challenge.model_answer: {休み|やすみ}はスペインの{方|ほう}がいいと{思う|おもう}。でも、{由紀|ゆき}のおかげで{日本|にほん}の{会社|かいしゃ}のことがよくわかったよ！
challenge.hint: 〜の方がいいと思う · 〜のおかげで
challenge.explanation: 〜の{方|ほう}がいいと{思|おも}う gives a clear opinion by comparing. {由紀|ゆき}のおかげで thanks her for a good result (you understand more now). Plain form and よ fit a close friend on LINE.

vocab.jp: {休日出勤|きゅうじつしゅっきん}
vocab.reading: きゅうじつしゅっきん
vocab.note: {休日|きゅうじつ} day off + {出勤|しゅっきん} going to work. {休日出勤|きゅうじつしゅっきん}する.
Handouts, data, slides for a meeting: {会議|かいぎ}の{資料|しりょう}.
{文句|もんく}を{言|い}う = to complain. {文句|もんく}ない = no complaints, perfect.
{上|じょう} above + {司|し} in charge. Opposite: {部下|ぶか} (subordinate).
{偉|えら}いじゃん! = good for you. {偉|えら}い{人|ひと} = an important person.
Verb stem + {方|かた} = way of doing: {働|はたら}き{方|かた}, {読|よ}み{方|かた}.
Praise, but can mean 'too serious'. Slang: マジ comes from it.
Pass something to someone's hand. {渡|わた}る = to cross (a road, a bridge).
{何|なん}とかなる = it'll work out. {何|なん}とかする = I'll manage it.
{自信|じしん}がある / ない. Not {地震|じしん} (earthquake): same sound.

kanji_study.parts: 亻 person radical + 韋 (to go around, surpass) → a person who goes beyond the others: great, admirable.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 違 (differ): 偉 has 亻 person on the left, 違 has ⻌ road around it.

kanji_study.parts: 氵 water radical + 度 (degree, times) → getting across the water step by step: cross; passing something across to someone: hand over.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 度 (degree, times): 渡 adds 氵 water on the left.

extras.title: Office words
extras.intro: What {由紀|ゆき} and her colleagues talk about every day.

items.note: {残業|ざんぎょう}する = work late.

items.jp: {定時|ていじ|regular finishing time|3}で{帰る|かえる}
items.note: The dream of many office workers.
Much more common now than 20 years ago.

extras.title: Ways to give an opinion
extras.title_jp: {意見|いけん}の{言い方|いいかた}

items.note: A soft opinion phrased as a question.

items.jp: {私|わたし}はスペイン{派|は|camp, side|3}かな
どっちとも{言えない|いえない}
items.note: Useful when you don't want to choose.
